title: Saturday strength + 12-3-30
subtitle: ~60 min · Lifetime Reston · 12-3-30 first, then everything at ONE bench
feeling: Rested after a light week. Hamstring feels a little off (not painful). Want a real workout, then I need to study.
note: Grab one bench plus a few dumbbell pairs and don't move. Rest about 60 sec between supersets and finish each set with 2 reps left. Skip anything that tugs the hamstring. On the incline, drop to 8-10% if the back of the leg complains.

sections.label: Cardio first · listen to your interview prep

items.name: Ramp up: incline 3, easy pace (warms the hamstring)
12-3-30: 12% incline, 3 mph (ease to 8-10% if hamstring objects)
One-arm DB row, hand on the bench
Seated DB shoulder press (10-15 lb each)
DB rear delt fly, chest on incline bench (5-10 lb)
Goblet squat to the bench (light, controlled)
Quad, chest and lat stretch (skip deep hamstring stretching)
